examples.title: Open a .p12 and export its certificate chain as PEM
An RSA key signs PKCS#1 v1.5 — summary verdict only

description: Open a PKCS#12 (.p12 / .pfx) in one call with `password` (or PKINATIVE_MCP_PASSWORD; SECRET_REQUIRED without one): the RFC 9579 PBMAC1 MAC is verified, every PBES2 SafeContents decrypted, every key unwrapped by the host straight into a NON-EXTRACTABLE Web Crypto key — described (algorithm, handle type, usages) and never exported — every certificate parsed (compact refs) and every CRL counted. The verdict is valid + integrity ('verified' | 'unverified' | 'mismatch') + reasons[]; a negative verdict is a REPORT, never isError: a wrong password or altered file → integrity 'mismatch' + PKI_REASON_PKCS12_MAC_MISMATCH (nothing decrypted); a legacy RC2 / 3DES file → PKI_REASON_PKCS12_ENCRYPTION_UNSUPPORTED (convert it once with openssl pkcs12 -legacy then -export -pbmac1_pbkdf2); no MAC or a legacy MAC → PKI_REASON_PKCS12_INTEGRITY_UNVERIFIED unless allowUnverifiedIntegrity:true (trusted origin only); an RSA key without `rsaScheme` ('pkcs1' | 'pss', hash default SHA-256; no default scheme) → PKI_REASON_PKCS12_RSA_SCHEME_UNSPECIFIED with that key's signingKey null. `exportCertificates:true` attaches a PEM bundle of the certificates then the CRLs (PEM only; inline embedded resource or a sandbox .pem file, never overwritten) — only from a file that opened; nothing is exported otherwise, and never a key. No result carries a key byte, a bag value or the password; a call with a password is never cached. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary' (valid, integrity, reasonCodes, counts). Prefer inspect_pkcs12 first: it describes the file (MAC kind, bags) without any password.

allowUnverifiedIntegrity.description: Accept a file whose integrity cannot be checked (no MAC, or the legacy RFC 7292 Appendix B MAC) and report it valid — only for a file whose origin you trust: without a MAC any unencrypted bag can be swapped, and a file with nothing encrypted then opens under any password. The report says integrity:'unverified' either way.

encoding.description: Artefact encoding: 'pem' (RFC 7468 text), 'der' (raw bytes), 'hex' (lowercase hex in structuredContent, inline only, ≤ 64 KiB). Default 'pem'.

encodingRules.description: 'der' (strict X.690 DER, default) or 'ber' (indefinite / non-minimal lengths and constructed strings, as legacy CMS producers write).

exportCertificates.description: Attach a PEM bundle of the certificates (CERTIFICATE blocks) then the CRLs (X509 CRL blocks) as the `artefact` — only from a file that opened (valid:true); never a key.

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep after verbosity (arrays map over elements); unmatched paths land in _meta.unmatchedFields.

hash.description: The hash of the RSA signature algorithm (with rsaScheme only). Default 'SHA-256'.

limits.description: Raise pkinative's 22 named security bounds for this call (trusted input only; absent keys keep the engine defaults). A value above an operator ceiling (PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_KDF_ITERATIONS, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_PATHS_EXPLORED) is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED; describe_engine lists the defaults and the ceilings.

maxAttributes.description: The attributes of one attribute set. Default 256.

maxBerSegments.description: The segments joined from one BER constructed string. Default 10000.

maxChainLength.description: The certificates one certification path may hold. Default 10.

maxCmsCertificatesAndCrls.description: The certificates and revocation entries one SignedData carries. Default 1024.

maxDepth.description: The nesting depth of constructed values. Default 64.

maxExtensions.description: The extensions of one certificate or request. Default 256.

maxGeneralNames.description: The GeneralName entries of one field. Default 10000.

maxInputBytes.description: The size of one DER input, or the length of one PEM text. Default 67108864.

maxIntegerBytes.description: The content length of one INTEGER converted to a bigint. Default 8192.

maxKdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iteration count honoured in one derivation. Default 10000000.

maxNameAttributes.description: The attributes of one distinguished name. Default 1024.

maxNodes.description: The number of values decoded from one input. Default 200000.

maxOcspSingleResponses.description: The SingleResponse entries of one OCSP response. Default 256.

maxOidBytes.description: The content length of one OBJECT IDENTIFIER. Default 256.

maxPathsExplored.description: The candidate paths explored while building one (the RFC 5280 §6 work bound). Default 1000.

maxPemBlocks.description: The blocks read from one PEM text. Default 10000.

maxPkcs12Bags.description: The SafeBags read from one PKCS#12, across every SafeContents. Default 4096.

maxPkcs12KdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iterations one PKCS#12 costs in total. Default 10000000.

maxPolicies.description: The policies or policy mappings of one extension. Default 1024.

maxPolicyNodes.description: The live nodes of the RFC 5280 valid_policy_tree. Default 4096.

maxRevokedCertificates.description: The entries walked in one CRL revokedCertificates list. Default 1000000.

maxSignerInfos.description: The signers of one SignedData. Default 64.

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default) returns the artefact inline as an embedded resource (≤ 50 MiB). 'file' writes it inside PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR (never overwrites; ≤ 1 GiB) and returns a resource_link.

outputPath.description: Relative path inside the sandbox (only when outputMode='file'); the extension must match the encoding (.pem only — a bundle has no DER form). Key-bearing extensions (.key .p8 .p12 .pfx) are refused: nothing here writes a private key.

password.description: The password of an encrypted PKCS#8 key or a PKCS#12 file (UTF-8). Never echoed, logged or cached. Alternatively set PKINATIVE_MCP_PASSWORD in the server environment and omit this input (never both) — the variable keeps the secret out of the model transcript.

pemMode.description: 'strict' (RFC 7468 exactly, default) or 'lax' (tolerates whitespace, line length and RFC 1421 headers).

pkcs12.description: The PKCS#12 file (.p12 / .pfx; DER, or BER with encodingRules:'ber' for a Windows-written PFX): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

rsaScheme.description: What an RSA key will sign with: 'pkcs1' (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5) or 'pss' (RSA-PSS). No default: without it an RSA key is not imported and the verdict says PKI_REASON_PKCS12_RSA_SCHEME_UNSPECIFIED. Ignored by keys of every other kind.

strict.description: Escalate the first engine warning to a PKI_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of listing it in diagnostics[].

name: open_pkcs12

outputSchema.description: PKCS#12 opening verdict (keys described, never exported). Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

artefact.description: With exportCertificates:true on a file that opened: the PEM bundle (certificates then CRLs), delivered once as the embedded resource (text) or the resource_link; summary counts the blocks.

hex.description: The artefact as lowercase hex (when encoding='hex').

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the DER bytes (lowercase hex) — the reproducibility proof.

certificates.description: Every certificate that parsed, in encoded order — the keys' own and any chain the file carries.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal concerns the engine raised (PKI_DIAG_*, de-duplicated, at most 200; explain_code explains one).

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when distinct diagnostics beyond the 200 listed were dropped.

exportSkipped.description: exportCertificates was asked but the file did not open (valid:false): nothing was exported.

integrity.description: 'verified' for a matching PBMAC1 MAC; 'unverified' when it could not be checked (no MAC, legacy MAC); 'mismatch' for a wrong password or an altered file — nothing was decrypted then.

keys.description: Every private key bag, in encoded order: where it was, its names, the certificate sharing its localKeyId, and the non-extractable Web Crypto handle described (never exported).

signingKey.description: The signing key described (algorithm; handle type, algorithm, extractable:false, usages); null when it could not be opened — the reasons say why.

reasons.description: Why the verdict is negative (empty when valid): the engine PKI_REASON_* codes, each with the standard it cites and the path of the offending element. A reason is returned, never thrown.

errorCode.description: The PKI_* error the parser would have thrown (PKI_REASON_INPUT_MALFORMED).

valid.description: Everything opened and the integrity verified (or explicitly waived). false is a negative verdict (reasons[]), never an error.

title: Open PKCS#12 (MAC, decryption, non-extractable key import, certificates; optional PEM bundle)
